## Why CRA, not another DPB reorder

Public schema-2 evidence around RPS_E decode pictures 24–34 already showed:

| Picture | Public fact | Still unknown |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 28 / POC32 CRA I | I command `0x2d020000`; no collocated lookup | header SPS/PPS words, scaling, QP/deblock, coded-data size |
| 29 / POC28 first bad Gst decode | Lookup matches completed intra writer 28; motion `0x2d00889a`; no motion address | QP/deblock/weights for that P/B slice; whether VA vs Gst packed those words identically |
| 31 / POC31 first bad VA decode | Lookup matches inter writer 30; dependent flag clear; motion `0x2d0488ca` plus address | same unmeasured slice/header words |

The measured reference/motion subset agreed across clients after resolving
slots to writers. A DPB reorder is not justified by that negative result.
The smallest useful next question is whether the **non-reference** commands
built from SPS/PPS/slice/scaling/weights around that CRA also agree, and
whether they match the source packing in this map.

## Exact fields and hooks

Experimental recorder only (separate `hooks.patch` child). Do not replace
shipped patches. Add record kinds after the existing start/table/list/motion
kinds, still limited to pictures **24–34** (CRA 28 is already inside that
window). Retain 300-picture writer history.

| Kind | Hook | Publishable fields | Keep private |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Header flags | after `hevc_set_flags()` / `hdr_2c`/`hdr_5c`/`hdr_60` `push` | actual appended words, SPS/PPS flag bits used | none if words only |
| Scaling | after `set_scaling_lists()` or the disabled `push(0)` | whether the list path ran; word count; first/last word | full 4x4/8x8 matrices may be hashed rather than dumped |
| QP | `stream_slice_dqtblk` `AVD_OP_QP` push | word, init_qp_minus26, slice_qp_delta, chroma offsets | none |
| Deblock | same function `AVD_OP_DBLK` push | word, SAO bits, tc/beta, FLAG_EN inputs | none |
| Weights | `stream_weights` | whether default header-only path ran; count of extra weight/offset words | individual weights if bulky; at least the enable decision |
| Coded slice | `set_slice` | size, data_byte_offset, NEW_SLICE/NEW_TILE flags | absolute `coded_in` DMA |

Existing tooling **cannot supply full VA controls**. Userspace
`hevc-reftrace` has DPB/slice type/POC, not SPS/PPS/scaling/QP/weights.
A kernel dump of those controls at `avd_hevc_run_preamble()` (after the
existing copy path) is required to compare packing without guessing zeros.

## Window, bound, privacy, errors

- Window: command detail pictures 24–34 of RPS_E **and** RPS_B (B is the
  negative control; it already has intra-collocated pictures).
- History: all 300 starts/completions, as today.
- Bound: current 2,048-record capacity plus a few words per picture in the
  11-picture window. Overflow or extra slice/entry (existing error bit 32)
  still invalidates the run.
- Privacy: relative sizes and appended command words; no DMA bases.
- Missing/error: reject runs with `num_slices != 1`, tiles/entry points, or
  recorder errors. Do not normalize unknown controls to zero.

## Distinguishing outcomes

1. VA vs Gst QP/deblock/header words differ at E-29 while B matches →
   control-path discrepancy; stay in userspace/kernel packing before firmware.
2. Words agree and match this source map, RPS_E still wrong → still not a
   firmware proof; next rank is compressed-reference contents / firmware
   state (out of this leaf).
3. Words disagree with this source map on both clients → packing/RE
   contract bug; do not treat the implementation as an oracle.

Compressed-reference and firmware-state measurement ranks **after** this
input audit.
